context_policy.rule: Every scheduler must begin from the complete repository state for its checked-out revision, load config/operator_directives.json as the latest explicit operator authority, then read the live champion, scheduler registry and architecture manifests. When older PR text, tests, comments or inferred policy conflict with the operator directives, the directives win. Research that reintroduces live expert averaging, semantic-price averaging, heterogeneous global PCA, an obsolete V7 bounded-policy rollback, or cleanup before validated V7 deployment is non-promotable.

grafana.rule: The canonical URL and dashboard UID remain stable while the dashboard data source follows the manifest-selected paper champion.

security.rule: SSH private keys and other credentials must remain outside version control.
